places.name: Balmorhea State Park
places.coord_point: park location as printed on the TPWD page (point type not stated)
places.blurb: Spring-fed desert oasis: a large CCC-built swimming pool fed by San Solomon Springs, restored cienegas, and mountain views.
places.status_note: TPWD alert (Jan 1, 2026 notice): online overnight reservations close at 4:30 p.m.; day passes often sell out in summer. The pool has no lifeguard.
places.notes: Ten candidates considered: Pinpoint, Lodestar, Vesperline, Starwake, Umbra, Tallowlight, Lanternfall, Meridian, Gnomon, Starboard. Chosen: Pinpoint. Coordinates: TPWD printed latitude/longitude 30.945036, -103.786663. Wikipedia infobox 30.94444, -103.78528 differs by 0.15 km, so the official point is used. Acres 46 from the Wikipedia infobox (the TPWD page gives only the pool area, 1.3 acres). Camping per the TPWD campsite page: 34 sites; sites 12-17 are tent-only with electricity; pull-through sites do not allow tents; one group campsite. Lodge is the motel-style San Solomon Springs Courts. No dark-sky designation found.

places.name: Cedar Hill State Park
places.coord_point: park location as printed on the TPWD page (point type not stated)
places.blurb: Dallas-area state park with trails and campsites from full hookups to hike-in primitive sites and group camps.
places.status_note: TPWD alert: trails close for wet weather and maintenance; check trail status. Argentine ants reported in some campsites; treat gear.
places.notes: Coordinates: TPWD printed 32.621721, -96.979087. Wikipedia infobox 32.60583, -96.99917 differs by 2.58 km, which is over the 2 km threshold, so the official point is used and the disagreement is recorded here. Wikipedia names Dallas as nearest city; TPWD says the park sits in the City of Cedar Hill, so nearest_town is Cedar Hill. Acres 1,826 from Wikipedia. The TPWD campsite page does not say whether tents are allowed on the electric sites; primitive hike-in sites exist.

places.name: Enchanted Rock State Natural Area
places.coord_point: park location as printed on the TPWD page (point type not stated)
places.blurb: Pink granite dome in the Hill Country and an International Dark Sky Park, with tent sites and hike-in primitive camping.
places.status_note: TPWD alert (Oct 20, 2026): backcountry trails may close intermittently for new-area development. Permitted-hunter closures listed for Nov 2-6, Nov 30-Dec 4 and Jan 25-29 (years not printed).
places.notes: Coordinates: TPWD printed 30.496033, -98.819952. Wikipedia infobox 30.49611, -98.82 differs by 0.01 km. Dark Sky: the darksky.org place page lists it as a Dark Sky Park, designated 2014; the IDA press release of Aug 6, 2014 also covers Copper Breaks SP. TPWD publishes Bortle 3 on its dark-skies page (lp_published). The darksky.org text says the park spans Gillespie and Llano counties; the Wikipedia infobox lists Gillespie, so county is given as Gillespie. Camping: walk-in tent pads with water nearby, hike-in primitive sites (no water), and a group camp at Buzzards Roost (groups only). Acres 5,388 from Wikipedia.

places.name: Government Canyon State Natural Area
places.coord_point: park location as printed on the TPWD page (point type not stated)
nearby: Honey Creek State Natural Area (24 mi)
places.blurb: Limestone canyons and grasslands near San Antonio, with more than 40 miles of trails and walk-in tent and group camps.
places.status_note: TPWD alert: permitted-hunter closures listed for Nov 16-20, Nov 30-Dec 7, Jan 4-8 and Jan 11-15 (years not printed). Check the alert page for trail closures.
places.notes: Coordinates: TPWD printed 29.549316, -98.764715. Wikipedia infobox 29.548, -98.765 differs by 0.15 km. Acres 13,067 from Wikipedia. Camping per the TPWD campsite page: walk-in tent pads 20-60 yards from Parking Lot D, plus walk-in group tent camps; water nearby. Wikipedia lists San Antonio as the nearest city. The campsite page calls this a sensitive natural and cultural resource area and asks for Leave No Trace.

places.name: Lake Colorado City State Park
places.coord_point: park location as printed on the TPWD page (point type not stated)
places.blurb: Quiet West Texas lake park near Colorado City with electric and water campsites and group sites.
places.status_note: TPWD alert: headquarters closed every Tuesday and Wednesday (notice Jan 1, 2026). Courtesy dock closed (notice Oct 23, 2025).
places.notes: Coordinates: TPWD printed 32.318219, -100.936476. Wikipedia infobox 32.31833, -100.93639 differs by 0.01 km. Acres 500 from Wikipedia. The campsite page lists electric pull-through sites, electric sites and sites with water; it does not say whether tents are allowed, so tent is left off. Group sites listed.

places.name: Martin Dies, Jr. State Park
places.coord_point: park location as printed on the TPWD page (point type not stated)
places.blurb: East Texas lake park with screened shelters, electric RV sites, and nearly 14 miles of paddling trails.
places.status_note: TPWD alert (Oct 29, 2026): burn ban, no wood or charcoal fires in fire rings. 100 and 200 camping loops and Hen House Ridge restrooms closed for construction through Feb 2027.
places.notes: Coordinates: TPWD printed 30.846627, -94.165869. Wikipedia infobox 30.85222, -94.17083 differs by 0.78 km. County Jasper per the Wikipedia infobox; not checked against a county boundary map. Acres 705 from Wikipedia. Camping: 50-amp and 30-amp electric sites (Hen House and Walnut Ridge areas), sites with water, and screened shelters. Tent camping is not stated on the campsite page, so tent is left off.

places.name: Possum Kingdom State Park
places.coord_point: park location as printed on the TPWD page (point type not stated)
nearby: Lake Mineral Wells State Park (30 mi)
places.blurb: Brazos River lake park with clear blue water, electric RV sites, walk-in primitive sites and lakeside cabins.
places.status_note: Cabins 1-6 closed December through February for renovations (notice Jul 9, 2026). Hunter-only closures Dec 4-7 and Dec 11-14. Shady Grove loop usually closes for winter.
places.notes: Coordinates: TPWD printed 32.873573, -98.559331. Wikipedia infobox 32.86944, -98.56111 differs by 0.49 km. Acres 1,528.7 from Wikipedia, rounded to 1,529. Wikipedia infobox nearest city is Caddo; Graford is nearer in the distance list. Camping per the campsite page: electric sites in Spanish Oaks (no tent pads) and Shady Grove (no tent pads; RVs 25 ft or less only), water-only lakeside sites, and walk-in primitive sites (no tent pads). Cabins 1-6 come from the TPWD alert page. Tent camping is not explicitly stated. The TPWD alert page fetched Oct 30, 2026 lists no fire closure. Internal project notes mention an August 2026 wildfire near this park; a web search did not confirm it.

places.name: Tyler State Park
places.coord_point: park location as printed on the TPWD page (point type not stated)
nearby: Martin Creek Lake State Park (44 mi)
places.blurb: East Texas park with a lake and trails, tent and full-hookup RV sites, screened shelters and group camps.
places.status_note: TPWD alert: EZ and loops A-D trails closed Oct 17, 2026 for a special event (date has passed). Boat rental notice on the alert page.
places.notes: Coordinates: TPWD printed 32.481414, -95.289441. Wikipedia Texas article 32.47778, -95.2925 differs by 0.50 km. The Wikipedia title Tyler State Park is a disambiguation page; the Texas article (Tyler_State_Park_(Texas)) was used. Acres 985.5 from Wikipedia, rounded to 986. Camping per the campsite page: Lakeview full-hookup sites (tents allowed on tent pads), Big Pine full-hookup sites (no tents), screened shelters, group sites.

places.name: Padre Island National Seashore
places.coord_point: Malaquite Visitor Center (NPS physical address and coordinates)
places.blurb: Gulf barrier island with dunes and beach, lagoon-side camping, and no hookups. First-come, first-served; no reservations.
places.status_note: No reservations accepted: first come, first served, self-issued camping permits, 14-night limit. No electric or water hookups. Primitive beach camping may close for hazards. Cell service very limited.
places.notes: Point: Malaquite Visitor Center from the NPS directions page, 27.42425 N, 97.29908 W, physical address 20420 Park Road 22, Corpus Christi TX 78418. NPS warns GPS may place the address several miles off. The Wikipedia infobox point 26.98444, -97.38056 is about 49.6 km from the visitor center and was not used. County: Nueces, from an NPS map label surfaced by a web search; the park also spans Kleberg, Kenedy and Willacy counties. The visitor-center point was not checked against a county boundary. Acres 130,434 from Wikipedia. Camping: Malaquite Campground and Bird Island Basin Campground (tent or RV; no hookups), and primitive beach camping at North Beach, South Beach and Yarborough Pass; camping is not permitted on Malaquite Beach. No dark-sky designation found in darksky.org searches.

places.name: Rita Blanca National Grassland
places.agency: USDA Forest Service (Cibola National Forest and National Grasslands)
places.coord_point: Thompson Grove Picnic Site (best-known developed site; official FS coordinates)
places.blurb: Shortgrass prairie in the Texas Panhandle with a free picnic site at Thompson Grove and wide open sky.
places.status_note: No recreation fees are collected on the Rita Blanca sites. The official page lists picnicking at Thompson Grove; camping is not listed. Check fire danger and the Clayton, NM office (575-374-9652, weekdays) before going.
places.notes: Point: Thompson Grove Picnic Site, official FS coordinates 36.4145919, -102.80584534 (fs.usda.gov, Cibola National Forest and National Grasslands). The Kiowa and Rita Blanca ranger office is in Clayton, New Mexico, outside Texas, so it is not the point. The Wikipedia infobox point 36.434, -102.6 is the grassland centroid, about 18.5 km away, and was not used. Acres 92,989 from Wikipedia (77,463 in Texas, 15,860 in Oklahoma). Official FS page: 10 picnicking units, restrooms, no drinking water, picnic tables. Camping is NOT listed on the official page; third-party sites describe informal overnight parking and report conflicting stay limits, so camping and camping_kinds are null. The official FS pages list fire danger as High on the Thompson Grove page and Moderate on the regional page; check current conditions. Felt Picnic Site is the other picnic site on the region page; no coordinates were found, so it is not listed. County Dallam per Wikipedia.
